title: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, agrees to sell some assets to Disney for $20 million
snippet: Character.AI said on Monday it had filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the US and agreed to sell some of its assets to Walt Disney for $20 million.   The AI entertainment platform said it intends to continue operating as it completes the sale.

title: Nvidia's China AI-chip share falls as Huawei closes gap, report finds
snippet: Nvidia's share of China's market for data-centre AI chips fell to 34% in the first half of 2026, as US export controls restricted supplies of its products and domestic rivals led by Huawei gained ground, according to an IDC report seen by Reuters.
